## New papers
### battery recycling
#### Direct cathode regeneration at room temperature (preprint — not yet peer-reviewed)
Lee, Park and Sato — 28 Oct — https://arxiv.example/abs/2610.01234
**Method** — regenerated used NMC cathodes in a salt solution at 25 °C instead of smelting them.
**Found** — recovered 94% of the original capacity over 500 cycles.
**Limits** — tested on NMC chemistry only.

#### Sorting black mass with magnets
Ruiz and Ito — 27 Oct — https://arxiv.example/abs/2610.04321
**Method** — sorted shredded battery black mass with a magnetic separator.
**Found** — recovered 81% of the cobalt.
**Limits** — none stated in the abstract.
